d: Short, choppy jet black hair with jagged bangs framing a youthful face and a mischievous expression in narrow, deep crimson eyes. A slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved button-up shirt with a red necktie, layered under a red and black open jacket, paired with a short black pleated skirt and a black thigh strap with a small utility pouch. The ensemble is completed with black ankle socks and brown heeled boots, while the character holds a black katana with a red-wrapped hilt.
